recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片中，大部分是胞質充滿空泡的巨噬細胞；細箭頭指的細胞胞質深藍、核偏一側且核旁有淡染區（hof），是漿細胞，在腹水中看到這種細胞應想到骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Plasma cells (thin arrow) with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round nucleus, clock-face chromatin and paranuclear hof
Several additional plasmacytoid cells with dense blue cytoplasm scattered in the field
Numerous large vacuolated macrophages with folded or reniform nuclei; thick arrow marks a macrophage with engulfed material
Occasional neutrophils and small lymphocytes; rare red cells
describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a mixed population dominated by vacuolated macrophages with reniform nuclei, one containing phagocytosed material (thick arrow). Scattered among them are plasma cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and paranuclear hofs (thin arrow). Occasional neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous involvement of the peritoneal fluid; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda immunostaining or flow cytometry (CD138/CD38).

ddx.dx: Reactive polyclonal plasma cells in effusion
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, cytologically mature and polytypic for kappa/lambda, whereas myeloma cells are monotypic and may be binucleate or show nucleoli.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, a two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral brush border/'skirt' and often form clusters, and they are calretinin-positive rather than CD138/light chain-restricted.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show larger immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, lack a myeloma history and are often HHV-8 or EBV positive.
